A refined dish made by wrapping a fresh fish in fragrant wild greens and cooking it.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Steamed Fish}}
A refined dish made by wrapping a fresh fish in fragrant wild greens and cooking it.|Recipe Book|TotK}}{{Cite|{{Big|Steamed Fish}}
A refined dish made by wrapping a fresh fish in fragrant wild greens and cooking it.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== [[Link]] can make Steamed Fish by [[Cooking]] a [[Fish]] with any [[Vegetable]], herb, or [[Flower]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. There are two methods to make the default version of this [[Meal]]. The first way is to cook either [[Hyrule Bass]]es or [[Sanke Carp]]s with [[Hyrule Herb]]s, as none of these [[Ingredient]]s provide any [[Added Effect]]s. Alternatively, Link can use Ingredients with contradicting effects, which will cancel out. Link can heal some of his [[Heart]]s by eating these Fish. They are considered a refined dish. Based on both the type of Fish used and the kind of herb, Vegetable, or Flower used, Link can make several different variations of Steamed Fish: * '''Hearty Steamed Fish''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Steamed Fish}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
A refined dish made by wrapping a fresh fish in fragrant wild greens and cooking it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Bass]], [[Hearty Salmon]]s, [[Hearty Radish]]es, [[Big Hearty Radish]]es, or other hearty Ingredients. When eaten, they heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him [[Extra Hearts]]. * '''Energizing Steamed Fish''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Steamed Fish}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
A refined dish made by wrapping a fresh fish in fragrant wild greens and cooking it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Staminoka Bass]]es or other energizing Ingredients. These [[Meal]]s will refill some of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]] when he eats them. * '''Enduring Steamed Fish''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Steamed Fish}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
A refined dish made by wrapping a fresh fish in fragrant wild greens and cooking it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Endura Carrot]]s or other enduring Ingredients. Link's Stamina Wheel will be completely replenished and overfilled when he consumes them. * '''Hasty Steamed Fish''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Steamed Fish}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
A refined dish made by wrapping a fresh fish in fragrant wild greens and cooking it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Swift Carrot]]s, [[Swift Violet]]s, or other hasty Ingredients. By eating them, Link will receive a boost to his movement speed. * '''Spicy Steamed Fish''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Steamed Fish}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
A refined dish made by wrapping a fresh fish in fragrant wild greens and cooking it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Warm Safflina]]s, [[Sizzlefin Trout]]s, or other spicy Ingredients. Consuming these meals will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Electro Steamed Fish''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Steamed Fish}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
A refined dish made by wrapping a fresh fish in fragrant wild greens and cooking it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Electric Safflina]]s, [[Voltfin Trout]], or other electric Ingredients. They can be eaten to give Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Mighty Steamed Fish''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Steamed Fish}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
A refined dish made by wrapping a fresh fish in fragrant wild greens and cooking it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Mighty Thistle]]s, [[Mighty Carp]], [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]], or other mighty Ingredients. If Link eats them, he will receive a boost to the power of his attacks. * '''Tough Steamed Fish''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Steamed Fish}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
A refined dish made by wrapping a fresh fish in fragrant wild greens and cooking it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Armoranth]]s, [[Fortified Pumpkin]]s, [[Armored Carp]], [[Armored Porgy|Armored Porgies]], or other tough Ingredients. Link's [[Defense]] will be increased by eating these meals. * '''Sneaky Steamed Fish''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Steamed Fish}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
A refined dish made by wrapping a fresh fish in fragrant wild greens and cooking it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Blue Nightshade]]s, [[Silent Princess]]es, [[Stealthfin Trout]]s, or other sneaky Ingredients. When eaten, Link will receive a boost to his [[Stealth]]. * '''Chilly Steamed Fish''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Steamed Fish}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
A refined dish made by wrapping a fresh fish in fragrant wild greens and cooking it.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Cool Safflina]]s, [[Chillfin Trout]]s, or other chilly Ingredients. Eating these will grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Steamed Fish returns in {{TotK}}. Like in {{BotW}}, it can be made by [[Cooking]] any type of [[Fish]] with a [[Vegetable]], herb, or [[Flower]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Steamed Fish appears in {{AoC}} as an unlockable [[Recipe]]. The Recipe is unlocked after completing the [[Scenario]] "[[Road to the Ancient Lab]]". Steamed Fish reduces the damage [[Warrior]]s take from [[Enemy|Enemies]] by 5%. It is is made using two [[Hyrule Herb]]s and two [[Hyrule Bass]]es. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Steamed Fish Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Steamed Fish icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
